items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Exploitation attempts have been detected in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security-Feature Bypass) in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output (Arbitrary Code Execution)
items.summary: A critical Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce that could result in unauthenticated arbitrary code execution without user interaction.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unrestricted upload of dangerous file types, which could result in arbitrary code execution and elevated access. Exploitation requires user interaction.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (versions up to 3.16.0) allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (versions before 1.11.12) allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront page.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization flaw allowing remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the affected application.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique. A fix was released in Magento 2.4.9.
